newsitem.title: KAZAKHSTAN: Kazakh c.bank reserves rise to 93.80 bln tenge.
newsitem.headline: Kazakh c.bank reserves rise to 93.80 bln tenge.

text.p: Kazakhstan's net reserves of hard currency and gold rose to 93.80 billion tenge ($1.24 billion) as of June 1 from 92.31 billion on May 1, the National Bank said on Wednesday.
It said rising gold prices on international markets drove reserve value up in May by 0.83 billion tenge. Net currency reserves grew by 0.65 billion tenge.

NOTE -- June 1, 1996 data provided in dollars only and calculated on the basis of 75.55 tenge per dollar and a gold price of $345.75 per ounce. The bank did not provide a breakdown of currency and gold reserves for last year.
